Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.pdfviewer

Class PdfDocument

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.pdfviewer.PdfDocument
public class PdfDocument extends Object
The PDF backend of the PdfViewerPanel: an Apache PDFBox (Apache-2.0) adapter that rasterises one page at a time to a BufferedImage.

The class is deliberately AWT-free apart from BufferedImage so it is the natural headless unit-test seam: opening, paging and rendering are exercised without an X display. Page numbers exposed here are 1-based (the convention a reader expects); PDFBox itself is 0-based, so the conversion happens inside this adapter.

A zoom of 1.0 means "100 %" and maps to a 72 DPI render, because PDF user space is defined at 72 units per inch; a zoom z therefore renders at 72 * z DPI.
